# Trigunaï Innovations (TrigunAI) — Live AI Cohorts, GPU Provided

> TrigunAI runs small live AI cohorts where the NVIDIA GPU is provided and you ship a real
> project. Taught by founder Deepak Kumar — who has shipped a VR app to the Meta Quest store and
> trained a drone cinematography policy in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. NVIDIA Inception member. The recorded
> modules and the "AI is the Universal Mind" series are free on YouTube (English + Hindi); the paid
> product is the live cohort. Philosophy: free to understand, paid to transform.

## Courses (live cohorts)
- [Build Agentic AI Systems](https://learn.trigunai.com/courses/agentic): 3-month live cohort — build an AI agent that does a real job of yours. GPU provided. ₹35,000.
- [Machine Learning & Its Math](https://learn.trigunai.com/courses/ml): live cohort — ML foundations + math, trained hands-on on a provided NVIDIA GPU. ₹49,000.
- [Build & Ship Your First VR/MR App](https://learn.trigunai.com/courses/vr): live cohort — zero to a shipped Meta Quest app with Meta SDK + Unity, by a founder with an app on the Quest store. ₹35,000.
- [Physical AI / Robotics](https://learn.trigunai.com/courses/robotics): waitlist — reinforcement learning + sim-to-real in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, GPU provided. ₹49,000.

## What makes it different
- The NVIDIA GPU is provided — you train on real hardware, not slides.
- Live and small — taught by the founder, not pre-recorded only.
- You ship a real project by the end.
- Taught by someone who has actually shipped: a Meta Quest app + a trained Isaac Sim drone policy.

## Free resources
- [AI is the Universal Mind — YouTube series (EN)](https://www.youtube.com/@TrigunAI-Innovations): 7 animated episodes on how AI mirrors the mind — attention, learning, imagination, meaning, intuition, will, getting better.
- [AI is the Universal Mind — हिंदी](https://www.youtube.com/@trigunai-हिंदी): the full series in Hindi.
- All VR/MR course modules are free and public on YouTube (English + Hindi).
